title: Known-object test, TOI-6667.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-6667.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 93 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 31 distinct event(s), 11 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2461197.3537 (ΔT 2114.03 d); 29 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
